services.name: Rotten trim and sill repair
services.blurb: Soft wood cut out to sound stock, new wood spliced in, primed on all six sides.

services.name: Porch posts, rails and floors
services.blurb: Rotted post bases scarfed with new wood, wobbly rails rebuilt, soft boards replaced.

services.name: Window sash and jamb repair
services.blurb: Sticking or drafty old sash freed, sash cords restrung, rotten sills patched in place.

services.name: Matched trim and molding
services.blurb: Casing, baseboard and crown milled to the old profile so the new piece disappears.

services.name: Built-ins and window seats
services.blurb: Bookcases, window seats and cupboards fitted to crooked old walls, scribed tight.

services.name: Stairs, rails and balusters
services.blurb: Creaks silenced from below, loose newels made solid, missing balusters turned to match.

services.name: Doors that stick or won't latch
services.blurb: Old doors planed, rehung and squared so they swing and latch through every season.

services.name: Shelving and closet fit-outs
services.blurb: Closets rebuilt with solid wood shelves, rods and drawers sized to what you own.

services.name: Framing repair
services.blurb: Sagging joists sistered and weak headers replaced before new finish work goes on.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Our front porch posts on Munjoy Hill were punky at the bottom. Abbie cut away the rot and spliced in new oak bases. You honestly cannot find the joint once it was painted.
reviews.name: Theo M.

reviews.text: Two sills on the north side had gone soft. They showed me with an awl exactly where the good wood started, patched both, and primed them before the rain came in.
reviews.name: Ingrid P.

reviews.text: We wanted a window seat under the bay in our 1890s house and none of the walls are square. The seat sits tight to the plaster all the way around. Cushion fits perfectly.
reviews.name: Rafael D.

reviews.text: Upstairs windows had not opened since we bought the place. Now all six go up and stay up. Quick, tidy, and they vacuumed the sills.
reviews.name: Colleen B.

reviews.text: The previous owner tore out the casing in the dining room. Scarf & Sash took an offcut from the hall, had the profile matched, and installed it. Even my father-in-law could not tell which was which, and he notices everything.
reviews.name: Hannah W.

reviews.text: Start date slid by a week because of a storm, but they texted me two days ahead with the new day. Stair rail is rock solid now.
reviews.name: Marcus O.

proof.guarantee: If a joint we made opens up or a repair rots back within 3 years, we come back and fix it.
